title: Dashboard Experience
summary: A dashboard-wide quality-of-life pass adds global search, notifications, personalization, safer editing, faster workflows and deeper links between BOM tools.

sections.title: Command Deck
items: Added Ctrl/Cmd+K global command search across ships, Wiki articles, builds, Port Battles, feedback and map locations.
Added a unified notification center for Feedback activity, releases and Port Battle assignments.
Added Favorites, Recently Viewed, breadcrumbs, a personalized dashboard home and an account quick-action menu.
Added per-member dashboard preferences for density, reduced motion, compact navigation and a customizable mobile Command Dock.
Added a consistent toast system with contextual Undo actions, improved focus states and global loading skeletons.

sections.title: Safer & Faster Workflows
items: Added unsaved-change protection and draft recovery to Ship Builder editing.
Added build duplication, hull swapping, section clearing, equipment favorites, recent equipment, build-completeness indicators and a warnings drawer.
Added a Port Battle readiness summary, bulk captain selection, conservative auto-placement, recent assignment context, user-defined target templates and safe undo for the last roster assignment.
Added saved Map views, persistent layers/search/view state, marker favorites and shareable marker links.

sections.title: Reference & Feedback
items: Ships now remember view/filter/compare state and support direct links to individual hulls.
Wiki articles now support favorites, recent history, copy-link, read/print modes, article outlines, related articles and backlinks where available.
Feedback now remembers filters and suggests likely duplicate bugs or suggestions while a member is writing a report.
New releases surface as a dismissible What's New card until the member has seen them.
